scope: Only exhaustive opaque cached uniform ray-query scattering. Omit negligible shadowed local-light connections before ray query; all other paths remain strict.

reference.logic: Renderer minContribution defaults to .001 and volume traversal terminates below that contribution. Adopt the bounded low-contribution omission principle, independently adapted to weighted direct-light connections, not the same upstream estimator.

bound.lightUpperBound: unoccluded light radiance * attenuation * medium Beer factor * HG phase; opaque surface visibility is in [0,1]
bound.sampling: Unchanged sample locations, RNG, steps, selection, integration, and all non-negligible queries
